Definition: to advise; reflexively, to deliberate or resolve
BiblicalUsage: 1) to advise, consult, give counsel, counsel, purpose, devise, plan; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to advise, counsel, give counsel, consult; 1a2) counsellor (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to consult together, exchange counsel, deliberate, counsel together; 1c) (Hithpael) to conspire
